outcome_evaluations.result: Fortune and Euronews supplied two selected families absent from the prior seven editions, and all three protected finalists passed playback. The rolling seven-edition diversity target still requires future completed cycles.
Thirty searches produced five bundle-verified selected mappings. This measures adoption and yield only; incremental editorial benefit and causal uplift remain unknown.

The AlphaProof paper received full review but was not selected because the event repeated a recently published topic. The novelty gate prevailed, so deeper review did not prove a better production outcome.
